title: Record the V45 triple intersection
body:
## Summary
- The normals `7`, `42` and `45` satisfy `7 xor 42 = 45`, so the third hyperplane is the sum of the first two.
- The generators `256, 128, 64, 35, 16, 11, 5` span all 128 vectors of that intersection.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
